subject: Scheduling: Intro demo for Fintra (from webinar)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wang <sam.wang@fintra.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Scheduling: Intro demo for Fintra (from webinar)

Hi Sam —

Thanks for signing up for our 'Scaling LLMs in production' webinar last week and for hanging around during the Q&A. I promised someone from the team would follow up to get a short product walkthrough scheduled.

Quick note on who I think should join from your side: a platform/infra engineer and whoever owns vendor evaluation. From our side I'll bring an AE + solutions engineer.

A couple of 30-min slots that are open on our side (ET):
- Wed 11/17 10:00–10:30
- Thu 11/18 15:00–15:30
- Fri 11/19 11:00–11:30

If none of those work, please suggest a couple windows next week and we can accommodate. If helpful, you can also pick any time on my calendar here: https://cal.com/grace/redwood-30m

Agenda we can cover in 30 min (we'll tailor to your priorities):
- Quick product demo (inference, latency/cost controls) — 15 min
- Deployment options: hosted vs private — 7 min
- Q&A + next steps (MAP + pricing) — 8 min

Thanks again for joining the webinar — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
SDR, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
[Cal link: https://cal.com/grace/redwood-30m]

From: Sam Wang <sam.wang@fintra.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@fintra.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:04:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Intro demo for Fintra (from webinar)

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the follow-up. We enjoyed the webinar — especially the parts about cost controls. A few notes on our side so you can tailor the demo:
- Primary focus: multi-tenant security and KMS integration (we handle regulated customer data)
- Secondary: predictable per-request latency for interactive flows and unit cost estimates

Availability: next week is better for us. Pref windows (ET):
- Tue 11/23 14:00–16:00
- Thu 11/25 15:00–17:00

If you can do a 30 min focused session that hits the two priorities above, great. Also looping in Priya (head of platform) for calendar coordination.

Best,
Sam
Director, Platform Engineering, Fintra
sam.wang@fintra.com
Phone: +1 617-555-0192

Are you able to take the demo? If so, can you pick one of those windows and I'll propose to the customer. Also attaching the attendee list from the webinar for context.

Date: 2026-11-17T09:30:00-05:00
Subject: RE: Scheduling: Intro demo for Fintra (from webinar) — proposed times + agenda

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the note and for sharing priorities — I'll run the demo and tailor it to KMS and latency guarantees. Proposed 30-min slots (ET):
- Thu 11/18 15:00–15:30 (preferred)
- Tue 11/23 14:30–15:00 (backup)

Proposed 30-min agenda (customized):
1) 6–8m: Deployment options & KMS/HSM integrations (how customer keys are used, audit trail)
2) 12–14m: Live demo showing latency under a 95th percentile SLA and cost-control knobs (quantization, batching)
3) 6–8m: Q&A + mutual action plan next steps

I've attached a draft mutual action plan that maps milestones and owners (pre-demo discovery items, trial provisioning, security questionnaire timeline). Please review and let me know if you'd like any changes.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf [attachment: mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf (PDF)]

If Thursday 11/18 15:00 ET works, I'll send a calendar invite with a short pre-demo checklist (accounts, examples, any sample queries you want us to run).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Marissa —

Thursday 11/18 15:00 ET works for us. Please send the invite and include an optional Zoom link (we typically use our own meeting room but a vendor link is fine).

Two quick requests for the session:
- If you can surface the KMS integration doc during the call that would be helpful
- If possible, run a short example with a 512-token prompt to show latency numbers and how batching affects cost

I'll send a calendar hold from our side once I receive the invite. Priya will join as well.

Thanks,
Sam
